constructor.notice: Bind this contract to the ERC-20 USDC supplied by the deployer.

createEscrow(address,uint256,uint64,byte.notice: Deposit USDC for a distinct payee, with a future refund deadline.

createLink(uint256,bytes32,string).notice: Create a payment link; amount zero allows each payer to choose the amount.

createPlan(address,uint256,uint64,uint64.notice: Create a recurring plan paid by the caller; a past start is clamped to now.

createSplit(address[],uint16[],string).notice: Create an immutable split of 1 to 50 entries whose basis points total 10,000.

escrowsOf(address).notice: Return escrow identifiers involving an address as payer or payee.

execute(uint256).notice: Execute exactly one due installment; anyone can call.

getEscrow(uint256).notice: Return an existing escrow; unknown identifiers revert.

getLink(uint256).notice: Return an existing link; unknown identifiers revert.

getPlan(uint256).notice: Return an existing plan; unknown identifiers revert.

getSplit(uint256).notice: Return an existing split, including its recipients and weights.

isDue(uint256).notice: Whether a plan is active and time-due; does not check balance or allowance.

linksOf(address).notice: Return identifiers of links created by an address.

pay(address,uint256,bytes32,string).notice: Pay a recipient directly; an optional memo is limited to 140 bytes.

payLink(uint256,uint256).notice: Pay an active link directly to its creator.

paySplit(uint256,uint256).notice: Pay a split; zero rounded shares are skipped and the last entry receives the remainder.

plansOf(address).notice: Return plan identifiers involving an address as payer or payee.

refund(uint256).notice: Return an active escrow to its payer: payee anytime, payer strictly after expiry.

release(uint256).notice: Allow only the payer to release an active escrow to its payee.

splitsOf(address).notice: Return split identifiers created by an address.
